Description: Verify that applying a country filter recomputes failing article counts, citation counts, reason badges and the order inside the selected scope instead of filtering the globally computed list. Covers AC-1.
Test name: TC-GEO-1120-001 - Country filter recomputes counts, badges and order within scope
Test step: Given the user is on the Actions Center Target Sources list with "All Markets" selected
Expected result: The Target Sources list is displayed on the ALL tab and source A is ranked above source B
QA Precondition: A completed analysis covering at least two markets (e.g. France and Germany). Source A carries both IMPROVE VISIBILITY and IMPROVE PERCEPTION badges on All Markets, but in France only its brand-absent failing articles exist. Source B is ranked below source A on All Markets but has more failing articles than source A in France. Global and per-market failing article and citation counts per source are known from reference data.

Test name: TC-GEO-1120-001 - Country filter recomputes counts, badges and order within scope
Test step: When the user selects France in the markets filter
Expected result: The markets filter shows France and the Target Sources list re-renders

Test name: TC-GEO-1120-001 - Country filter recomputes counts, badges and order within scope
Test step: Then the counter lines of each source count only the failing articles of the France scope
Expected result: The card of source A shows "Not visible in N articles" with N equal to its France-only count, not its All Markets count

Test name: TC-GEO-1120-001 - Country filter recomputes counts, badges and order within scope
Test step: And the reason badges are recomputed inside the France scope
Expected result: Source A shows the IMPROVE VISIBILITY badge only and the IMPROVE PERCEPTION badge is no longer displayed

Test name: TC-GEO-1120-001 - Country filter recomputes counts, badges and order within scope
Test step: And the citation counter of each source reflects the France-scoped answers only
Expected result: The citation counter of source A equals its France-only reference value, not its All Markets value

Test name: TC-GEO-1120-001 - Country filter recomputes counts, badges and order within scope
Test step: And the order of the list is recomputed inside the France scope
Expected result: Source B is now displayed above source A
